purpose: Physical router correctness acceptance of R113 FD/frame-boundary repair, not performance acceptance.

fd_boundary.expectation: C and R113 exit0 and identical six-case output, known bad R112 exits1 and exactly reproduces three misassociation/body-FD signatures; witness, no-leak and final object/fd checks must pass.

existing_protocol.expectation: C, R112, R113 seven existing protocol groups identical.

before_fix_test: New first-frame FD regression fails R112 with [false,true] versus [true,false].
production: C throughout; guarded disposable namespaces; every window verifies boot/config/mounts/production identity and cleanup. No installation.
decision: Any unexpected exit, output, descriptor lifetime, identity or cleanup failure stops further windows and retains evidence. Oracle validation is prerequisite but not the final router verdict.
